Chat request with temperature=0 for deterministic responses

```python title="Python"
import asyncio
import os
from liter_llm import create_client
from liter_llm._internal_bindings import ChatCompletionRequest

async def main() -> None:
    client = create_client(api_key=os.environ["API_KEY"])
    req = ChatCompletionRequest.from_json("{\"messages\":[{\"content\":\"Say hello\",\"role\":\"user\"}],\"model\":\"gpt-4\",\"temperature\":0}")
    result = await client.chat(req)
    print(result.choices[0].message.content)

asyncio.run(main())
```
